units.source_text: 正在这个时候，同属相国寺的有阅历的某寺住持仙游了。

en.t: Just then, the experienced abbot of a certain temple that also belonged to Shokoku-ji passed away.

units.source_text: 老师应邀参加新任住持的太庙仪式，这次轮到我做陪同。

en.t: The teacher was invited to attend the installation ceremony for the new abbot, and this time it was my turn to accompany him.

units.source_text: 老师没有故意排斥我不许我作陪，我也就由衷地盼望：也许在往返途中会有机会向他解释清楚的吧。

en.t: Since the teacher had not deliberately excluded me or forbidden me to go with him, I sincerely hoped that perhaps, on the journey there or back, I would have a chance to explain everything to him clearly.

units.source_text: 临行的头天晚上，又追加一名新太庙的弟子作陪，我所寄予的期望，一半已成了泡影。

en.t: On the night before our departure, another companion was added, a disciple of the newly installed abbot, and half of the hopes I had placed in the trip had already vanished like foam.
